ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) with a high-intensity (white) pixel ratio estimated at approximately 0.08.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary surface consists of a continuous dark field. Spatial mapping reveals high-contrast white circular focal points distributed across both lobes. Distinctive high-contrast white linear ribbing is localized along segments of the trailing edges.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow, obtuse U-shaped notch with an approximate angle of 150 degrees and a low depth-to-width ratio.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular and jagged topography. Notable high-amplitude peaks and valleys, including a deep, jagged excision on the distal third of the left lobe and multiple smaller notches across the right lobe trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges exhibit a concave sweep from the median notch toward the distal tips, significantly fragmented by acquired structural irregularities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of multiple discrete, roughly circular high-contrast white pixel clusters (barnacle scars) distributed quasi-randomly across the dark ventral surface of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Prominent clusters of parallel, high-contrast white linear streaks (rake marks) oriented vertically on the upper margins of both the left and right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant physical trauma evidenced by a large, irregular jagged notch in the left lobe trailing edge and multiple sets of healed rake marks.
other_distinctive_markers: The specific parallel 'comb-like' scarring pattern on the upper edges of both lobes is a highly unique visual marker.
